newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen stuck in range near 124.00.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen stuck in range near 124.00.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract is likely to be stuck in range trade near 124.00 on Monday, traders said.
JGBs may be boosted, however, if investors begin buying cash bonds actively, a trust bank trader said.
Last week, there was talk that city banks bought JGBs in large lots, and market will watch to see whether other investors follow suit, the trader said.
If the June breaks above 124.20, it may next make a try for 124.72, although such a rise is unlikely to take place on Monday, a trader at a trust bank's securities unit said.
The second trader said that there may be some focus on Japan's May domestic vehicle sales data at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT).
"The figures will be for the period after April, so it will be necessary to keep watch over the data," the trader said.

The last trading day for the June contract will be June 9, but last-minute buy back pressure ahead of a benchmark shift from the June to the September contract is not likely to be very strong, the trader said.
"Moves related to the (forthcoming) shift in benchmark status are past their peak, now that the June JGB futures options have expired."
